description: This file defines the TvSplashRedirectActivity class, which is an Android activity responsible for deciding whether to launch the TV index activity or the main activity based on device features. It acts as the launch/entry point for the application on all devices, performing a splash/redirect function.

classes.name: TvSplashRedirectActivity
classes.description: An Activity that determines whether the device has TV features and redirects to either TvIndexActivity or MainActivity accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the Activity's onCreate method to set up the splash/redirect logic based on device features.
